title: Patient With Sudden Vision Change
description: A graphic designer wakes to a new floater, a faint shadow, and a couple of flashes in one eye, and the clinic moves her into a same-day slot. The case walks the urgent visit from the phone call through dilation to a methodical look at the far edge of the retina. The verdict is a peeled gel and a sound retina, wrapped in a written safety net and a booked second look. A case episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks about calm triage, timing, and follow-through.
